183:t_109:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Come at me! I'll teach you until you're sick of it that I, $$流竜馬$$, am here on Earth!」

183:t_110:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
($$サイデリアル$$ surely has enemies stronger than even $$バルビエル$$...)

183:t_110:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
(But I'll win...! If sorrow spreads any further through this world, one day the damage will be irreversible...!)

183:t_110:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
(Chief, $$トビー$$... I'll fight. In our pride and joy... this $$バルゴラ・グローリー$$...!)

183:t_111:0.en:
$$レド$$
「This is outside the $$人類銀河同盟$$'s area of operations...」

183:t_111:1.en:
$$レド$$
「But I'm a member of $c now. I'll fulfill that duty, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

183:t_111:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. This unit respects your judgment and likewise desires to achieve the greatest possible combat results.」

183:t_112:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Wait for me, $$ティファ$$! I'll take care of these guys in no time!」

183:t_112:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Here we go, you bastards! I'll wipe out anyone who makes $$ティファ$$ sad!」

183:t_113:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
(Your Majesty $$ディアナ$$... I'll put the power of the $$ホワイトドール$$ you entrusted to me to good use.)

183:t_113:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
(And Miss $$ソシエ$$... I'll return to you, I promise. Once I've ended all the fighting...!)

183:t_114:0.en:
$$勝平$$
「No matter how many of you come at us, don't think you can beat the great $$勝平$$ and $$ザンボット３$$!」

183:t_114:2.en:
$$恵子$$
「If you don't stay calmer, you'll get yourself killed someday!」

183:t_114:3.en:
$$勝平$$
「Shut up! If we lose in spirit, we'll never win!」

183:t_114:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Grandpa, Dad, Big Bro $$イチ$$! $$宇宙太$$, $$恵子$$, and I will fight to the end for the $$神ファミリー$$!」

183:t_115:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
「B-Big Sis! The enemy's coming! They're fast! They look strong!」

183:t_115:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I can see that for myself. If you're scared, go clean the $$クォーター$$'s baths.」

183:t_115:2.en:
$$ノノ$$
「N-no! $$ノノ$$ will fight too! Because...!」

183:t_115:3.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$ノノリリ$$ risked her life to protect Earth too!」

183:t_115:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Your idol, $$ノノリリ$$... I don't know who or where she is, but she sounds like a fine hero of justice.」

183:t_115:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Aren't you a hero of justice too, Big Sis?」

183:t_115:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「...When the enemy comes, I'll fight. That's our job in $$フラタニティ$$.」

183:t_115:7.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes! $$ノノ$$ will do her very best as a trainee member too!」

183:t_115:8.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Yes, yes. Just try not to get in my way.」

183:t_116:1.en:
$$ランド$$
「How many times do I have to tell you to stop that cheer!? It kills my enthusiasm!」

183:t_116:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't be ridiculous. I'm $$ザ・ヒート$$... I'm always raring to go!」

183:t_116:4.en:
$$メール$$
「Yeah! $$ガンレオン$$ answers you in Magna Mode too!」

183:t_116:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Then let's go! $$ビーター・サービス$$ is open for business!」

183:t_116:6.en:
$$メール$$
「Even though our real business is repairs!」
